title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V27
paragraphs: Lampy Paperwork is a browser-based workspace for building fixture patches, power calculations, Fan Out sheets, distro labels, and control/network paperwork for live entertainment.
V27 adds spreadsheet-style keyboard navigation and vertical drag-fill editing to Power Calculations and Distro Labels Table View without adding an external table dependency.
Use the arrow keys, Enter, Shift+Enter, Tab, and Shift+Tab to move between editable cells. Select a cell and drag its blue fill handle vertically to copy compatible values through a column.
Rack Layout includes Front, Side, and Rear views, configurable rack depth, front- and rear-mounted equipment, and automatic 100 mm cable-clearance checks.
Detailed rack views use the device line images from the equipment library. Configured DMX Node ports can display their assigned project-position colours directly over the matching sockets.

The current app also includes GDTF fixture information, MVR import and export, DMX universe viewers, position-linked patch data, phase-total summaries, RCBO warnings, Aux and 3ø output calculations, Fan Out sheets, IP address schedules, and revision tracking.

Fixture patches can be imported from CSV, Excel, XLSM, or MVR files and exported as PDF, Excel, or MVR. When an exact library match is available, the exported MVR includes the matched GDTF file and mode.
All project, GDTF, and MVR processing stays within your browser. Download your Lampy project file regularly so that you can reopen and continue your work later.
Use the Walk-through in the Actions menu for the recommended workflow and an overview of the current tools.
